build_policy.baseline_reuse: 0957 retained native and allocator executables byte-bound by descriptor
build_policy.profile: release, opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, debug=1, incremental=0, jobs=2

candidate_build.profile: release, opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, debug=1, incremental=0, jobs=2

candidate_change.description: Arc-shared Number representation candidate under review; candidate source is bound to the reviewed three-path delta.
candidate_change.extra_source_paths: fail closed unless explicitly reviewed and added before freeze
candidate_change.representation: Arc<str> shared lexical Number storage with borrowed lexical construction and exact integer construction

capture_order: bind and freeze both binaries and all helper descriptors
run static negative controls and seal their passed receipt
run native lane serially to terminal and seal all artifacts
run allocator lane serially to terminal and seal all artifacts
reduce only after both lane packets are sealed

claims.allocator: descriptive process-wide allocator counter evidence only
claims.native: paired evidence for this explicit fresh-process finite-context harness on the recorded host and affinity only
claims.rss: whole-process max RSS review evidence, not unique heap or allocator ownership

comparison.bootstrap_unit: six native block geometric means or three allocator paired repeats per case
comparison.pairing: adjacent A/B or B/A legs within each frozen block; never pair native with allocator

failure_policy.child_failure: stop lane at first failure, retain terminal and partial artifacts, never retry or replace
failure_policy.zero_denominator: fail closed for a claimed ratio; retain raw values and mark descriptive undefined only when no claim is made

allocator.claim: allocator reductions are descriptive; a >=5% reduction requires aggregate point <=0.95 and bootstrap CI upper <1.0 per named case/metric, with no production/adoption inference
allocator.safety: apply the same case-aggregate 1.05 review threshold; report all phase counters and fail closed on missing fields or zero denominators

controls.policy: the same 1.05 safety and p95 tail review applies; a control failure prevents a broad candidate claim

correctness: every child terminal completed once with return code 0 and no retry/replacement
source/output/semantic hashes, eager output, inverse restoration, sink bounds, and finite resource cleanup pass for both roles
configured workers=1 and observed worker permits=0; expected CpuTasks are 5/5/2 by case
candidate and baseline report schemas, case identities, context limits, and binary descriptors match the frozen role

native_primary.claim: a >=5% improvement requires case aggregate point <=0.95, bootstrap CI upper <1.0, and a practical effect check for the named case/metric; controls do not establish generality
native_primary.safety: the case aggregate ratio CI upper must be <=1.05; missing/zero/nonfinite values fail closed; individual paired-leg ratios above 1.05 are retained as review flags and are not silently discarded

native_secondary.safety: retain and flag any paired-leg or block ratio >1.05; publication is a control and no noisy secondary metric is an adoption hard gate

rss.claim: a >=5% RSS reduction requires aggregate point <=0.95 and bootstrap CI upper <1.0; never call it allocator evidence
rss.safety: the case aggregate RSS ratio CI upper must be <=1.05; individual pair/block ratios above 1.05 are retained as review flags
rss.scope: whole process including setup and oracle work

purpose: Fresh-process paired native and allocator comparison for an isolated Arc-shared Number candidate; no adoption claim.

allocator.scope: process-wide operation-scoped allocator counters; no latency claim
allocator.whole_process_metric: max_rss_kib from /usr/bin/time -v, separate from allocator peaks

schema_note: The v4 schema name is retained for the reviewed schedule and gate contract; this v6 binding records the Arc-shared Number candidate explicitly and binds positive allocator report-schema controls.

comparison_overlay.interpretation: identical generated root Cargo.lock is a comparison/build overlay; retained 0957 runtime baseline is unchanged

source.source_cache_state: fresh process and in-memory OwnedSource; no cold filesystem claim
